items.title: Case 1: [When source of sound moves towards the stationary observer] (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Case 1: [When source of sound moves towards the stationary observer]: a main subheading of 7.11 Doppler effect, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 163-163.

blocks.text: Jab source velocity uₛ se thehre hue observer C ki taraf chalta hai to waves compress ho (dab) jati hain aur un ki wavelength kam ho jati hai (saath wali Fig. 7.12). Waves itni amount se compress hoti hain:
Waves is liye compress hoti hain ke utni hi waves ab source ki velocity ki wajah se chhoti jagah mein aa jati hain. Is liye observer C ko yeh wavelength milti hai:

blocks.alt: Sound (awaz) ka source S velocity u_s se daen chalta hai; nuqte us ki lagataar jagahein hain. Us ke chhore gol wavefronts in jagahon par centre (markaz) rakhte hain, is liye daen taraf Observer C ki janib ghane aur baen taraf Observer D ki janib phaile hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.12: Source velocity uₛ se thehre observer C ki taraf aur thehre observer D se door chal raha hai. C ko barhi hui aur D ko ghati hui frequency sunai deti hai (kitab ki Figure 7.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Yahan Δλ ek second mein wavelength ki kami hai; ise Doppler shift kehte hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har wavefront us jagah se phailta hai jahan source use chhorte waqt tha. Source C ki taraf barhta hai, is liye C ki taraf wavefronts qareeb qareeb hain (chhoti wavelength, oonchi frequency) aur D ki taraf door door (lambi wavelength, neechi frequency). Kitab mein is figure ka number 7.12 dobara chhapa hai; yeh beats wali Fig. 7.12 se alag figure hai.
Is liye observer C ko ek second mein milne wali waves ki number (badli hui, yani apparent frequency) yeh hai:
Yani observer ko sunai dene wali frequency barh jati hai, aur sound ki pitch oonchi ho jati hai.
